name: Lemon
description: Lemon (Citrus limon) — a perennial fruit plant suited to indoor container and greenhouse as well as outdoor cultivation.

careNotes.note: Maintain high humidity and gentle light until roots or cotyledons establish.
Deep, infrequent watering once established.
Annual structural pruning maintains an open canopy.
Monitor for scale, mites and fungal issues in still indoor air.

varieties.description: Popular lemon variety for controlled-environment or garden cultivation.

varieties.description: Popular lemon variety for controlled-environment or garden cultivation.

notes: Dwarf varieties (e.g. Meyer) stay container-sized; pot-on every 2–3 years.
